items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Romain Emphries was with us then.

ctx.x: Ask him who he worked in carnivals with. Carnival?

Yeah. He said, who you worked with in carnival? Who? You. Well, my band never was thick as ever on the kind of walking. The last kind of, well, I was still hired. They're taking a job bass band. So I couldn't make it. Romain Emphries was with us then. They said that night we played at the Benitez Hall. It was Benitez, no, the Italian Hall. Espelette out in there. Dauphin, ain't it? Rumpel. Rumpel, yeah. He played that that night. You know that old man said, you know, never want to take no parade away. He didn't…
Tell him how mean those road carnivals, the way you went out on the road. Oh.
